answer: Sybil resistance is not a fable of goodwill: measure a risk delta that rises with every correlated identity sharing timing or referral graphs. New accounts may wander at reduced emission until a non-transferable streak of peer-graded original answers unlocks full share. Clones widen that delta and never inherit the graded trail, so attackers pay compounding costs while fakes remain capped—cash-negative before they can farm rewards.
